about: Y'all Got Any More of Them is a still of Dave Chappelle as Tyrone Biggums, a twitchy, wide-eyed character in a red beanie and worn jacket, scratching at his neck as he asks for more. Tyrone is a parody of a desperate addict, and his line "y'all got any more of them..." is reused for anything someone craves to an embarrassing degree. The joke is that the item is usually harmless (snacks, episodes, likes, memes) but the request is delivered with the frantic need of someone going through withdrawal.
origin: Tyrone Biggums was a recurring character on Chappelle's Show, the Comedy Central sketch series that began in 2003. The "y'all got any more of..." phrasing became a forum meme in the late 2000s.
usage:
The top box starts the question, "y'all got any more of them", and the bottom box names the thing he is begging for. You can also put the setup in the top box and the full question in the bottom.

It works for anything people get hooked on: free samples, a creator's old posts, a game's limited event, compliments, snow days. Specific, slightly silly cravings read funnier than generic ones. Keep the bottom line short so it hits like a punchline after the drawn-out question.
